usage.outputShape: body.data[] (array of destination locations; each .iataCode, .name, .subtype, .geoCode{latitude,longitude}, .address{countryName,countryCode}). body.meta.count = number of results.
quirks: This backend (#4) is the airport-routes route, NOT the locations/keyword search. The registry-level inputExample {keyword,subType} does NOT apply to this URL.
Required query param is departureAirportCode (a 3-letter IATA airport code like JFK). Without it the call would fail.
Optional max param caps result count; use max=1 for a cheap minimal probe.
Returns Amadeus direct-destinations data; meta.links.self exposes the underlying api.amadeus.com URL.
usage.guide: Call GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/reference/airport-routes with query params departureAirportCode (required, IATA airport code e.g. JFK) and optional max (result cap). Pay with x402 USDC on Base (~$0.005 per call, synchronous). Read the result from body.data[] — each item is a reachable destination with iataCode, name, and geoCode. body.meta.count is the total returned.
